newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at thinly steady levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at thinly steady levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at thinly steady levels Monday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Friday.
- Five barges, McGregor and South, Mid-Mississippi, one each week June, bid 107-1/2 percent, unchanged from May 7, offer115 percent.
- Eight barges, Illinois River, two each week of July, bid 95 percent of tariff, unchanged from May 9, no offer.
- Four barges, Illinois, one each week of September, bid 150 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, Mid-Mississippi, one each week of September, bid 150 percent, no comparison, no offer.
